text:
Remy: Proposal: introduce a 'shadow-observe' fallback mode for canaries. Not visible to callers; requests mirror to fallback variant and a tiny fraction are marked for in-console replay. Keeps production path unchanged but gives us deterministic diffs. Thoughts?
Asha: Love the idea. We need precise triggers: sustained error_rate > 0.04 over 5m, p95 latency +20% over baseline for 3m, or eval delta > 1.8% on a golden set.
Leo: Telemetry concerns: add fields fallback_mode (none|shadow-observe|hard), mirror_decision (true|false), trace_seed, decision_id, and a small artifact pointer (sha256 hashes only). Make optional.
Marta: UX: show a grey 'shadow observe' chip in rollout timeline. Panel shows mirrored RPS, matched responses, replayable sample count, and a button 'Open replay sandbox'.
Remy: API sketch (plain text): fallback:{ mode: "shadow-observe", triggers:[...], mirror_fraction:0.005, seed: "org:project:rollout:1797773333", billing: "same_as_original", audit_days:30 }
Asha: Billing: default to bill as original so customers don't get surprised. But make billing attribution configurable if infra wants target billing for chargeback.
Leo: Implementation: mirror decision must be local at edge. Compute sample_key = HMAC(seed, request_id || prompt_hash) mod 1e6 < mirror_fraction*1e6. That keeps deterministic picks. Emit decision_id = hex(HMAC(seed, request_id || timestamp)).
Marta: Replay UX: pick a sampled request, hit Replay -> runs against both variants in sandbox, shows token-level diff, latency, and a tiny colored diff summary. No full text unless customer opt-in and data-retention approved.
Remy: Audit requirements: store only hashes (prompt_hash, response_hash) and pointers to sanitized artifacts. Deletions require two admins and full audit trail.
Asha: Alerting: when mirrored responses diverge on eval metrics beyond threshold across N samples, create a grouped incident with code SHDW_QUAL and surface in both SRE and product channels.
Leo: Stats: add a small telemetry beacon per mirrored request: {decision_id, mirror_decision, fallback_mode, prompt_hash, response_hash, latency_ms}. Keep payload < 1kb.
Marta: Console actions: "Convert shadow -> hard fallback" and "Pause mirroring". Both create audit events, require operator reason; show a confirmation modal that lists downstream effects.
Remy: Security: all compute artifacts stored encrypted; raw text only stored if customer enables 'store-artifacts' with explicit opt-in. Otherwise we only keep hashes + minimal metadata.
Asha: QA: deterministic sampling tests (seed edgecases), replay correctness tests (same inputs produce same decision_id), and an end-to-end smoke where mirror -> detect divergence -> promote workflow is exercised.
Leo: Performance: keep mirror decision in proxy to avoid extra RPC latency. Mirrors should be async fire-and-forget to the sandbox path.
ops-bot: Recorded: rollout-shadow/1797773333 -> step id=shadow-2026-03-23-11
Marta: I'll mock wireframes for timeline + replay panel and include a small CTA explaining privacy controls.
Remy: I'll open RFC PR with API shape, telemetry schema delta, and the operator runbook (snooze, promote, audit). Assigning @Marta for mockups and @Leo for sampling impl. Thanks. :thumbsup:
